answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable deposit in escrow, like a sonnet whose strict form forces discipline: spawning thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and slashing burns the stake when one misbehaves. Reputation pools in a shared registry, a lagoon where new identities start near zero trust and must earn standing over time. A sybil operator hits the shale problem: each fake layer crumbles under the same stake-and-slash pressure, so mass fakery turns uneconomic while honest agents keep their deposits.
